text.p: Here is how major stock markets outside the United States ended Tuesday.

LONDON - Britain's FTSE 100 index scored its biggest one-day gain in point terms in five years in a rally that caught analysts and dealers by surprise after weeks of cautious trading. The FTSE 100 closed at 4,728.3, up 123.7 points, or 2.69 percent.

FRANKFURT - Stocks ended market trade at a new closing high as the export-dependent chemical sector stole the spotlight, drawing strength from the dollar's trading above 1.74 marks. The DAX-30 index closed at 3,819.85, up 34.08 points, or 0.90 percent. In later, screen-based trade the IBIS DAX index ended at 3,834.84, up 67.95 points, or 1.80 percent.

PARIS - Stocks extended their gains in afternoon trade, boosted by Wall Street's early advance on supportive U.S. data, to set a fresh closing high. The CAC-40 index closed at 2,944.04, up 85.78 points, or 3.00 percent.
ZURICH - Shares resumed their upward path following Monday's loss of more than 1 percent. The Swiss market index closed at 5,654.8, up 34.2 points, or 0.61 percent.

TOKYO - Stocks closed with hefty losses as a mixture of trepidation ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting and anxiety over the Nomura Securities Co. Ltd. scandal, which media reports say is widening, weighed on the market, brokers said. The 225-share Nikkei average closed at 20,175.52, down 429.44 points, or 2.08 percent.
HONG KONG - The stock market continues to be closed as Hong Kong celebrates its return to Chinese rule. The market reopens Thursday.

SYDNEY - Stocks ended barely changed from Monday's record levels as strong underlying sentiment won over an early bout of profit-taking on the first day of the new financial year. The All Ordinaries index closed 4.7 points lower at 2,721.2, down from a record close of 2,725.9 Monday.

JOHHANNESBURG - The easing of foreign exchange controls on South African individuals was welcomed by stocks, lifting the industrial index to a new closing high despite a tumble in engineering firm Murray & Roberts stock. The All-share index closed at 7,420.1, up 0.1 points, or 0.00 percent. The All Gold index closed at 968.6, up 3.6 points, or 0.37 percent, while the Industrial index closed at 8,808.7, up 18.2 points, or 0.21 percent.
